Grishkin is a [[NPCs (Silksong)|Merchant]] in [[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]. They are a member of the [[Flea Caravan]] and provide [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] the [[Flea Brew]].

== In-game Events ==
Grishkin can initially be found in [[the Marrow]] with the rest of the Flea Caravan. After the [[Flea Caravan]] moves to [[Greymoor]], Grishkin gives Hornet the [[Flea Brew]] as a reward, which can be refilled by interacting with the pot nearby for {{R|30}}. They provide this service to the [[Blasted Steps]] and [[Fleatopia]]

After the [[Festival of the Flea]] has commenced, Grishkin no longer charges Rosaries for refills, saying there is no reason to waste any brew when their future is decided.<ref>Grishkin: <i>"No charge for you if needing more. Why waste when future is final?"</i></ref> While they do not host any games, they can appear during [[Flea Juggle]].

== Location ==
Grishkin can be encountered alongside the [[Flea Caravan]] at [[the Marrow]], [[Greymoor]], [[Blasted Steps]] and [[Fleatopia]], as the caravan moves as [[Fleas]] are found.
